messages:
Marco D: Hi finance, shared taxi from CDG to hotel during conference. Driver gave an anonymous paper slip with no VAT number. Total €62.40 split between 3 of us. Can we still claim VAT back?
Sofia P: I was in the taxi too. Driver also asked if we wanted a printed receipt but just handed the little slip. I paid Marco back cash and he paid with card.
Marco D: I uploaded the photo of the slip to the expense app. It shows amount, date, and driver name but no business VAT or company name.
Expenses Bot: Reminder — for VAT reclaim you need supplier invoice with VAT number or a public transport receipt. Missing VAT number will prevent VAT recovery but expense can still be reimbursed as transportation.
Sam T: Finance rule: reimburse the full €62.40 pro rata if attendees confirm. For VAT reclaim, we need a formal taxi company invoice. If it's an independent driver, VAT not reclaimable. Please add attendee list and note "shared taxi CDG".
Finance Ops: If you want us to try, provide driver's phone or badge number so Ops can request an invoice from the taxi company. We'll mark expense EX-6721 pending VAT-check.
Marco D: Added attendee list (Marco, Sofia, Lena) and note. No badge number, but I have the driver's car reg: 7AB-123. I'll DM that to Finance Ops.
Sofia P: For splitting, do we each submit our share or one person submit and others reimburse internally?
Sam T: Submit one expense under Marco for full amount and add split lines in notes with each person's allocation. Put approvals from attendees in the comments. Finance will reimburse Marco and confirm internal transfers if needed.
Marco D: Done. Expense EX-6721 created and tagged `travel/europe`. Added reg number and photo. Thanks.
